meta_description:
29K likes, 424 comments - fit.khurana on September 22, 2025: "So THIS happened!! WE won🏆 

“Best Fitness Content Creator” - the 16 year old Vanshika who hated sports would have never imagined this. 

So much happened in 1.5 years - I built a community of 1.1 M while working 9-5 at JP Morgan. Touched thousands of lives, quit my job last week to pursue my dreams and winning this title today just makes me feel that I am on the right path🌸🧿 

Remember - Consistency and Discipline can take you to places you can’t even think of❤️ So never stop putting in your 200% daily✨

Thanks to every single person who voted for me, pushed me to post the best content out there and appreciated my work ❤️ I love you guysss🌸

Also, thanks to @exhibit_social and @exhibitmagazine for helping me check off my bucket list ✅❤️".
